answer: Summit work-slot deposit burn: an identity claims a summit slot at an oasis yard, locking a 70-credit bond. A rotating jury of strangers re-runs the work at the summit against the oasis table; fake work burns the bond to ember, half to the jury. A rented-slot ring fails because each task hash is recorded once. Each slot costs 85 (70 bond + 15 fee), so 1,000 fakes sink 85,000 against a 40,000 pool. The honest agent pays 15 and gets the bond back.
